**ShiftNest 12.4 (released 28 Oct 2026)**

Updates roll out automatically overnight. No action is needed for most customers.

**New:**
- Managers can approve shift swaps only for their own areas.
- Public holiday penalty rates now apply automatically for Hospitality and Retail awards, by state.
- Staff get push notifications for open shifts.

**Improvements:** Faster roster loading for large sites, unpaid break minutes in timesheet exports, and availability can be set 12 weeks ahead.

**Fixes:** Daylight saving hour errors on overnight shifts and South Australia time zone display.

**Action required (only if you use the v1 payroll connector, about 8% of customers):** Switch to v2 (about 15 minutes) or timesheets will stop reaching payroll. The shutdown was moved from 30 Nov to **31 Jan 2027**, but switching soon is still advised.
